name: Masumura Tsuyoshi
source: A door to door salesman who was touched by Emiko's kindness after she took care of him when he had a heatstroke while working. Soon, Emiko became his customer, and eventually, he fell in love with her. Unable to hide his feelings, Tsuyoshi confessed to her, but was rejected. Since then, he avoided Emiko, but one day, Emiko called his company and asked for him to deliver some products to her house. Confused, Tsuyoshi decided to...
